_comment: Monitor settings: the market time zone and the Telegram alert rules, checked on every 1-minute close. Edits are picked up on the next cycle, no restart needed. cooldown_minutes is global; any rule may set its own. The two trendline_break rules send only once per line.
_utc_offset_comment: the market clock (TAIFEX = Taiwan, UTC+8). Every 'now' in the monitor and dashboard is UTC + this, whatever the computer's own timezone, so travelling (e.g. Japan, UTC+9) needs no change. Read at startup: restart monitor.py and dashboard.py after changing it.

support_bottom_third._comment: close inside the support box, in its bottom part (0 = box bottom, 1 = box top)

resistance_top_third._comment: close inside the resistance box, in its top part

box_in_out._comment: previous 1-min close inside the box, latest close outside it, either side (support: up = held, down = broke; resistance: up = broke, down = held). Close only, no exit buffer

trendline_near._comment: close within distance_points of a drawn line; set distance_atr (e.g. 0.2) to use hourly ATR instead

trendline_break_below_up._comment: close below a rising line by more than buffer_points; sent once per line

trendline_break_above_down._comment: close above a falling line by more than buffer_points; sent once per line
